notes: 1.0.2 — The pitch wheel now bends every note, two semitones either way, in every voice mode, and the mod wheel adds a vibrato on top of whatever you route it to; MONO and ARP pass the wheels, the sustain pedal and aftertouch through. Windows: the zip carries its file names in UTF-8, so the sounds named with a ² or ³ extract correctly and CYBERPUNK, LIMINAL PLAIN, OUTER HORIZON and ORANGE load as they should. Also from 1.0.1: the wave and sample pickers open in place when the window is enlarged.
